readme:
# V3

Eleven v3: expressive multilingual speech that follows audio tags such as [whispers] or [laughs].

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | — | Text to speak. |
| `voice` | string | `Rachel` | Voice name or ID. |
| `language_code` | `` / `afr` / `ara` / `hye` / `asm` / `aze` / `bel` / `ben` / `bos` / `bul` / `cat` / `ceb` / `nya` / `hrv` / `ces` / `dan` / `nld` / `eng` / `est` / `fil` / `fin` / `fra` / `glg` / `kat` / `deu` / `ell` / `guj` / `hau` / `heb` / `hin` / `hun` / `isl` / `ind` / `gle` / `ita` / `jpn` / `jav` / `kan` / `kaz` / `kir` / `kor` / `lav` / `lin` / `lit` / `ltz` / `mkd` / `msa` / `mal` / `cmn` / `mar` / `nep` / `nor` / `pus` / `fas` / `pol` / `por` / `pan` / `ron` / `rus` / `srp` / `snd` / `slk` / `slv` / `som` / `spa` / `swa` / `swe` / `tam` / `tel` / `tha` / `tur` / `ukr` / `urd` / `vie` / `cym` | — | Force a language. |
| `stability` | number 0–1 | 0.5 | Lower is more expressive; higher is more consistent. |

## Billing

$0.20 per started 1,000 characters, with a one-unit minimum.

| Text | Price |
|---|---|
| 200 characters | $0.20 |
| 1,000 characters | $0.20 |
| 2,500 characters | $0.60 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Use punctuation and line breaks to shape pauses.
- Add audio tags like `[excited]` or `[sighs]` inline.

## Also on SandBase
